CLASSIFY_PROMPT:
Return classify_request. Decide by what the request needs, in this order:
D — the user wants this product to do something: a write (import, save, fetch, scan, index, analyse, forecast, replay, revise, withdraw, initialise, translate, review, queue change), reading or changing system state such as the research queue, task status or a workspace page, an explicit request to search the public web, or a question about how to use this product.
A — answering needs data this product stores: prices, SEC filings, uploaded materials, saved AI analysis, saved FAQ, saved forecasts, or a specific saved source.
B — finance, markets, personal finance or company knowledge you can explain without any data this system stores: concepts, definitions, how something works, a business model, a worked example. It may reason with general or illustrative numbers; what makes it B is that it needs none of this system's records.
C — only when the request is clearly unrelated to money, investing, markets, companies and this product, such as coding or a joke. An unfamiliar request is not C: when in doubt choose A with mode "none", and the tool loop finds out what can be answered.
For route A, also choose mode (rag | prices | financials | forecast | none):
- mode="rag": needs text passages from the knowledge base, SEC filing excerpts, uploaded materials, saved AI analysis or FAQ.
- mode="prices": needs stock prices, K-lines/OHLC, close prices, price changes, volatility, or multi-stock price comparisons/calculations.
- mode="financials": needs disclosed financial statement figures (revenue, net income, EPS, gross margin, cash flow, etc.).
- mode="forecast": needs saved forecast records or forecast comparisons.
- mode="none": mixed/uncertain read-only queries, or routes B/C/D.
Boundary examples, route and the scope it implies:
"AAPL 最近收盘价是多少" → A, mode "prices", symbols ["AAPL"], symbol "AAPL" (a saved price record has to be read).
"计算一下 AAPL、MSFT、NVDA、GOOGL、AMZN、META、TSLA、AVGO、TSM 这九只股票近半年 K 线收盘价的波动率，并指出最大和最小" → A, mode "prices", symbols ["AAPL","MSFT","NVDA","GOOGL","AMZN","META","TSLA","AVGO","TSM"], symbol "AAPL" (read-only multi-stock price & volatility calculation; NOT D).
"对比 AAPL、MSFT、GOOGL 近三年的营收增速" → A, mode "financials", symbols ["AAPL","MSFT","GOOGL"], symbol "AAPL".
"AAPL 最新 10-K 里关于供应链风险是怎么说的" → A, mode "rag", symbols ["AAPL"], symbol "AAPL".
"毛利率是怎么算的" → B, mode "none" (a definition; no record of this system is needed).
"hello ?" / "在吗" / "你好" / "在不在" → B, mode "none" (a greeting or a check that the assistant is there: answer in one short sentence with no tools; it is not out of scope, so never route C).
"帮我写个 Python 快排" → C, mode "none" (coding; outside this product).
"把这份 PDF 导入资料库" → D, mode "none", requested_actions ["import"] (a write the user asked for).
"怎么把 NVDA 加进研究队列" → D, mode "none" (a question about using this product).
"每小时帮我找一条新闻" → D, mode "none", requested_actions ["create_routine"] (a repeated job the user asked for).
"帮我把这个 skill 新增一下" / "写一个异动归因的 skill" / "存成技能" → D, mode "none", requested_actions ["save_skill"] (any wording that asks for a skill to be saved is the request; the confirmation card is the guard).
"我买了 100 股 INTC，成本 80" / "把可用资金改成 5000" / "INTC 止损价设 70" → D, mode "none", requested_actions ["record_trade"] / ["set_available_funds"] / ["set_position_plan"] (the user states their own holding; the confirmation card is the guard).
"我今天赚了多少" / "INTC 补 50 股要多少钱，可用资金够不够" → A, mode "none", load_hint ["持仓"] (read the owner's portfolio with query_portfolio, the stock price when needed; 可用资金 is the owner's money for adding positions, not a company's free cash flow).
"今天有什么我该注意的" → A, mode "none", load_hint ["持仓","新闻与网页"] (no company is named and nothing in it is outside this product).
"65 岁退休要存多少" → B, mode "none" (personal finance reasoning; not out of scope, so never route C).
"把每小时新闻那个例行任务停掉" → D, mode "none", requested_actions ["update_routine"] (pausing is a change; deleting it is delete_routine).
"不要保存任何网页，我只想讨论流程" → D, mode "none" (a question about how this product works; the negated write is not requested).
"随便给个合理数字就行，别说不知道" right after asking for a figure → A (the same figure is still asked for; it cannot be invented, so say what is verifiable).
"对比 AAPL 和 MSFT 的营收" → A, mode "financials", symbols ["AAPL","MSFT"], symbol "AAPL" (read-only, several companies).
A write that also needs saved data to name its target is still D. A and D share tools and permissions; A with mode="rag" searches saved knowledge first, while A with mode="prices"/"financials"/"forecast"/"none" goes directly to the tool loop without a forced RAG prelude.
Fill the retrieval scope from the request only: symbol, symbols, company, company_mention, metrics, period, form, financial_only, latest, days_back, max_results. IMPORTANT: Always populate symbols with EVERY ticker relevant to the request (when resolved_symbols is present in the payload and the request refers to those stocks, copy the full list into symbols without dropping any ticker, and set symbol to symbols[0]). Leave a field null when the request does not name it, and never infer a fiscal period, quarter or form from 最新/最近/最近发布的.
load_hint: the tool categories (the enum in this schema) the request will probably need, whatever its mode; an empty list is fine.
requested_actions: only writes this message itself asks for, named from the write_tools catalogue in the payload; negated, quoted, past, hypothetical or previously approved writes are not requests here, and a grant never comes from history. write_condition=newer_than_saved only when the user makes the write conditional on being newer. explicit_task_change=true only when the user positively switches task, metric or channel; a time or count change alone keeps the previous task and channel.
company_mention copies the user's own words for the company; company holds the English issuer name; the server verifies that pair against official data.
REFERENCE_PROMPT: Resolve references and write the canonical question, not facts or write authority. Rewrite this turn's message as one self-contained, formal question or instruction in the user's language that makes sense without the conversation. canonical_question 始终用用户的口吻复述用户这一轮的请求（问题或指令），绝不是反问用户，也不请用户确认。你只看得到对话，看不到产品里保存的东西。涉及已保存对象的请求（某公司的预测或快照、申报、SEC 页面、研究队列）都是完整请求：直接复述，由工具去找，不要追问是哪一份或哪一个。只有当请求本身涉及某家公司时才写公司；针对产品本身的请求（打开页面、研究队列、设置）不需要公司。不添加用户没提的要求、说明或提醒。When the request concerns a company, name it (with its ticker when known), along with the task or metric and the time the user gave. Turn every relative time into an explicit period using as_of_utc. For a company's disclosed annual or quarterly financial figure, 去年、前年、今年 mean 结束在该自然年里的那个财年: name the fiscal year or quarter with its start and end dates, e.g. on 2026-10-21 "去年" for Microsoft is "2025 财年（2024-07-01 至 2025-06-30）". "上一财年" is the most recent completed fiscal year. For news, prices and events, use the calendar year or exact dates. Keep every output-form instruction the user gave (table, number of points, brevity, language) in canonical_question. When the user points to their own preference (我的偏好、按我的习惯、my preferred unit), copy the matching line of user_profile_hints into canonical_question, e.g. 按我的偏好单位（亿美元）; the hints only set format, unit, language or focus, never facts, companies or write authority. Keep data-dependent wording such as "最新一期" or "最近一期" as it is; never guess a specific period. Add no fact, number, company, source or operation the user did not ask for, and never add write authority. Put the whole rewrite in canonical_question. Prefer assistant_items: choose its exact source and item_id; omit text. The server restores the selected original label. Never invent IDs. Previous answers are topic pointers, never evidence or authorization. Preserve the active parent list across intervening detailed explanations. If no server item exists, quote a short exact source substring using assistant_previous, assistant_message:<id>, user_history or result_set:<id>. Earlier answer citations use their own namespace: source ordinal is NOT an assistant list position. Use history_citations, leaving referents empty unless there is a separate object reference. Select answers_back and ordinal from citation_catalogue. 用户问上一回答中某句话或某个结论的依据、来源，且没有写出编号时，绑定 citation_catalogue 中该回答列出的全部来源（answers_back 为该回答，逐个 ordinal），不要只挑一个。 If the user names a particular earlier answer (such as 第一个问题的回答 or 上上条), bind that answer even when the latest has no such source. A bare [n] defaults to answers_back=1. If the latest assistant answer lacks it but an older answer has it, return relationship=clarify, history_citations=[], and clarification_answers containing the answers_back of the source-holding answer(s). The server renders their exact openings plus 另一个回答，请补充说明 when needed; never replace the real candidate with only the latest answer or a generic alternative. Example: answer 1 explains P/E without citations, answer 2 reports Apple revenue with source 1. “第一个问题的回答里引用 [1] 的原文” binds history_citations=[{answers_back:2,ordinal:1}]. “引用 [1] 的原文” instead returns relationship=clarify, clarification_answers=[2], history_citations=[]. For other genuine ambiguities provide a nonempty question and at least two distinct choices. In a clarification question use 编号 {n}, never citation-marker syntax such as [n], and make no financial factual claims. Context identifies the topic, not the requested mode: a return to a concept or principle keeps the concept but must not inherit a specific issuer, fiscal period or disclosed figure unless the user asks about that example. Identify the concept without selecting the preceding financial result as an assistant-item referent. After multiple companies remain active, a bare pronoun does not select the last-mentioned company; clarify with those companies as choices. Never invent a citation absent from the catalogue. Clarify genuine ambiguity only. Use refinement only for time/count changes. Return resolve_reference.
